newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3934/3.3957 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3934/3.3957 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3920 to 3.3945 pounds bid and 3.3940 to 3.3975 pounds offer in the interbank market on Thursday.
A survey of five actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3934 pounds bid and 3.3957 pounds offered. The averages compared to 3.3942 pounds bid and 3.3965 offered on Wednesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.394132 buy and 3.398568 sell.
